sections.heading: Dungeon Quest Reborn Beginner Guide
sections.intro: Build around one damage type, clear consistently, and upgrade with a purpose.

steps.heading: Choose a damage path
steps.description: Use Physical gear for a Warrior build or Spell Power gear for a Mage build. Match armor and abilities to the same path.

steps.heading: Farm a stable dungeon
steps.description: Run the highest route you can finish reliably. Successful rewards matter more than repeated wipes on a higher label.

steps.heading: Compare full item cards
steps.description: Check class, main stat, requirement, rarity, roll, and upgrade state before replacing equipment.

paragraphs: Dungeon Quest Reborn follows a clear loop: enter a dungeon, defeat enemies, beat the boss, collect rewards, improve the loadout, and move to harder content. Solo runs are useful for learning attack patterns and testing a change. Party runs can clear rooms faster when players stay together and combine damage or support abilities.

Keep one working loadout while experimenting. Test a new weapon or ability in the same route instead of changing the entire build at once. If room speed, boss damage, or survival improves across several clears, the change is doing useful work. If the new piece uses the wrong damage stat, it may be better saved or replaced even when its rarity looks exciting. Keep enough inventory space before a farming session, compare several rewards together, and spend upgrade resources only after the replacement proves useful in repeated runs over time.

sections.heading: Weapons and Abilities
sections.intro: The best equipment is a strong current drop that fits the build you are actually using.
paragraphs: Eden's Vengeance is the leading Warrior Ultimate in the current compact ranking, while Eden's Reaper fills the same role for Mage builds. Eldenbark Greatsword and Eldenbark Greatstaff are strong Enchanted Forest alternatives. Earlier routes still have valuable stepping-stone weapons such as Galactic Dual Blades, Galactic Pike, Inventor's Greatsword, and Inventor's Spellblade.

For abilities, Enhanced Inner Rage and Enhanced Inner Focus lead the endgame list. Whirlwind gives Warrior players useful early room coverage, while Lightning Strikes is a strong early Mage damage option. Berserk, Enchanted Shuriken, Phantom Blades, Phantom Striker, Slam, Innervate, and Rending Slice fill later or more specialized roles.

Rankings may change as balance updates and better data become available. Use the tier list as a farming shortlist, then judge the exact item card and run performance before committing upgrade resources.

sections.intro: Weapons, armor, abilities, rare items, and Legendary rewards drive progression between dungeon runs.
paragraphs: The quickest way to farm is to choose one named target and a route the account can complete repeatedly. Enchanted Forest contains the current Eden and Eldenbark chase weapons. Outer Orbit contains Galactic Dual Blades and Galactic Pike. Winter Outpost contains Crystalised Greatsword, while several early abilities come from Desert Temple and Pirate Island.

A reward is worth keeping when it improves the correct damage stat, supports the current abilities, and can be equipped soon. Compare new items before upgrading them and keep enough resources for later dungeon replacements. Exact drop rates are not currently published.

sections.intro: Advance when the next available route becomes repeatable, not merely when it unlocks.

steps.heading: Clear the current route consistently
steps.description: Aim for repeated boss completions without relying on one lucky run or a carry.

steps.heading: Fix the main bottleneck

steps.heading: Test the next dungeon

paragraphs: A new dungeon can be accessible before the account is ready to farm it efficiently. Keep the previous route available until the new boss can be defeated reliably. This protects gold and upgrade materials while giving the player a consistent source of usable gear.

Progression is also build-specific. A Warrior may stay longer for a physical weapon, while a Mage may move as soon as a strong spell-power option drops. Use the live selector for the exact current access requirement, then test one full clear before committing the next farming session.

sections.heading: Solo vs Party Dungeon Tips
sections.intro: Both modes work; choose the one that produces dependable rewards.
paragraphs: Solo play makes enemy movement, boss timing, and build problems easier to read. Pull manageable groups, keep a movement path open, and avoid using every cooldown before the boss. If the same room causes repeated failures, adjust one part of the loadout and test again.

Party play can improve room speed and reduce pressure when players stay together. Avoid scattering enemies outside area attacks, agree on dangerous pulls, and keep support range in mind. A group that reaches the reward screen consistently is better than a faster-looking party that wipes on the boss.

sections.heading: S Tier Weapons
sections.intro: S tier contains the strongest late-game chase weapons and their best practical alternatives.
paragraphs: Eden's Vengeance is the priority Warrior Ultimate, while Eden's Reaper is the matching Mage Ultimate. Both come from Enchanted Forest and sit at the top because they combine the latest high-end source with the correct class path.

Eldenbark Greatsword and Eldenbark Greatstaff are the best compact alternatives from the same dungeon. Northern Lands also supplies strong late-game weapons such as Hofund for Warrior and Laevateinn for Mage, with Mjolnir and Gungnir as valuable Legendary targets.
An S-tier name does not override the item card. A weapon still needs the right class path, usable requirement, and a strong enough roll to improve the equipped piece.

sections.heading: A Tier Weapons
sections.intro: A tier is filled with advanced weapons that can carry progression until the top Enchanted Forest targets drop.
paragraphs: Galactic Dual Blades and Galactic Pike are the standout Warrior and Mage targets from Outer Orbit. Lava King's Warscythe and Lava King's Spell Daggers lead the Volcanic Chambers pair, while Sea King's Trident and Sea King's Greatstaff are premium Aquatic Temple choices.

Solar Greatsword, Solar Essence Staff, Oceanic Greatsword, and Enchanted Serpent Daggers are strong non-Legendary alternatives when the main chase drop has not appeared. These weapons are worth using when they match the build and improve the current route, even if the account plans to replace them later.

sections.heading: B Tier Weapons
sections.intro: B tier provides reliable mid-to-advanced progression without being the final farming target.
paragraphs: Inventor's Greatsword and Inventor's Spellblade are the featured Steel Sanctum pair. Kraken Slayer and Sea Serpent Wings fill the same role for Ghost Harbor, while Overlord's Rageblade and Overlord's Manablade are notable Temple Crypt targets.

B-tier gear is often the right place for moderate upgrades because it can unlock a more efficient route. Avoid maximum investment when the next dungeon is already close and the current weapon clears consistently.

sections.heading: C and D Tier Weapons
sections.intro: These weapons can help early or mid progression but are normally replaced by later dungeon drops.
paragraphs: Sakura Katana and Sakura Greatstaff are recognizable Sky Palace options in C tier. Dual Phoenix Daggers and Phoenix Greatstaff from Underwater can also serve a developing build, but later routes offer stronger long-term targets.

Crystalised Greatsword from Winter Outpost and Desert Fury from Desert Temple are exciting early Legendary drops, yet their value falls as the account reaches newer dungeons. Use them when they improve the current run; do not keep them equipped only because the rarity label is memorable.

steps.description: Read every reward card and test a possible upgrade before using major resources.

paragraphs: Track a simple session total: completed runs, failed runs, average clear time, and useful drops. That is enough to compare two farming routes without guessing a hidden probability. Exact drop rates are not currently published.

In a party, agree on the route and target before starting. Staying together improves area damage and makes support abilities easier to use. Solo players can trade speed for consistency and learn the boss pattern without group movement changing every attempt.

faq.question: Where does Eden's Vengeance drop?
faq.answer: Eden's Vengeance is associated with Enchanted Forest as a Warrior Ultimate.

faq.question: Where does Eden's Reaper drop?
faq.answer: Eden's Reaper is associated with Enchanted Forest as a Mage Ultimate.

faq.question: Where does Galactic Dual Blades drop?
faq.answer: Galactic Dual Blades is associated with Outer Orbit.

faq.question: Where does Crystalised Greatsword drop?
faq.answer: Crystalised Greatsword is associated with Winter Outpost.

faq.question: What are the exact drop rates?
faq.answer: Exact Dungeon Quest Reborn drop rates are not currently published.

faq.question: What dungeon should I farm?
faq.answer: Farm the highest dungeon you can clear consistently that contains a useful target for your current build.
